newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE to list on Beirut bourse by Oct.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE to list on Beirut bourse by Oct.

text.p: Lebanon's biggest company SOLIDERE will move its shares from the private Beirut Secondary Market (BSM) to the official Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE) on October 1, market sources said on Monday.
"SOLIDERE has decided to move to the bourse on October 1. It informed the Beirut Secondary Market that the last day of trading there will be September 27," a market source told Reuters.

SOLIDERE has not announced the move but a source close to the company said preparations for it were underway. "If things go as planned, the move will be implemented by the beginning of October," he told Reuters.
The BSM, set up in 1994 under central bank auspices to trade SOLIDERE shares, had been informed, he added. The BSM trades only SOLIDERE shares.
Officials at the BSE said the move would inject new life into the market on which trade has been lacklustre since it reopened in January after a 13-year gap.
The capitalisation of the Beirut Stock Exchange -- which currently trades in only four companies -- is less than $400 million. SOLIDERE shares would add some $2 billion to the market.
